programmes.evidence: The research-intensive PhD in Business explicitly offers an Operations Management concentration, currently recruiting for Fall 2027. Its doctoral research covers design and improvement of manufacturing/service processes, supply chains, quality, retail/healthcare/platform operations and revenue management. The ISOM academic area is associated through the programme faculty listings.
limitations: Concentration recorded within the broad Business PhD, not a second separate degree. Academic area affiliation does not establish a separately constituted administrative doctoral department. Intake availability for other business concentrations is cycle-specific.

programmes.programName: PhD in Systems Engineering and Operations Research
programmes.department: Department of Systems Engineering and Operations Research
programmes.evidence: The current department explicitly offers one integrated Systems Engineering and Operations Research PhD. Official college overview describes doctoral optimization, simulation and systems research with transportation, healthcare, sustainability and business/government applications.
limitations: Integrated SEOR is one doctoral programme; MS Operations Research is not duplicated as an additional PhD.

programmes.programName: Doctor of Philosophy in Civil and Infrastructure Engineering
programmes.specialization: Transportation Engineering; Construction Engineering and Management research interest areas
programmes.school: Volgenau School of Engineering, College of Engineering and Computing
programmes.department: Sid and Reva Dewberry Department of Civil, Environmental, and Infrastructure Engineering
programmes.evidence: Current doctoral overview explicitly lists Transportation Engineering and Construction Engineering and Management among PhD interest areas and requires original dissertation research. Its graduate page links these to departmental research. Transportation research explicitly develops mathematical decision support for operating/managing systems, network analysis, traffic operations/simulation and congestion management; construction research includes lean construction and project/asset management.
limitations: A scoped research pathway in the broad Civil and Infrastructure Engineering doctorate, not all civil graduates in scope or a separately named Operations degree. Named PhD interest areas are not silently converted into formal concentrations; MS concentrations remain distinct.
